scope: 12 个 commit 的 evidence[] 重写（r8 A 类 13 条契约对应；image-original-detail-token-estimate 不动）

records.subject: Expose ChatGPT user IDs in `account/read` responses (#60004)
beforeEvidence: 缺 account/read 的 userId：auth/account.go:565 GetAccountResponse 只有 Account/RequiresOpenAIAuth/WorkspaceRouting；响应有两个构造点 appserver/runtime_router.go:14977 与 :15041，都要填
取值能力已在：auth.ChatGPTUserIDFromAuth（appserver/workspace_switching.go:64 在用）
plan: update/plan_2026_11_08_tail5.md §2（#60004），契约 account-read-user-id
afterEvidence: Go auth/account.go implements resolving the ChatGPT user id from the auth snapshot (ChatGPTUserIDFromAuth) for account/read responses; verified by TestAccountReadResponseCarriesChatGPTUserIDLikeRust

Go appserver/runtime_router.go implements filling that user id at every account/read response construction point, including the RequiresOpenAIAuth early returns and providerAccountResponse; verified by TestAccountReadResponseCarriesChatGPTUserIDLikeRust

records.subject: Expose agent tree IDs and environment removal (#60190)
beforeEvidence: environment 移除已对齐（appserver.EnvironmentManager.Remove + TestManagerRemove）；agent tree ID 缺失且语义不同（Go 用 root thread id 填 TreeID，重载不换新）
Go 锚点：agent/shutdown_report.go:64（TreeID 注释明确是运行时关联 id，不是 thread id）、:116 NewAgentTreeShutdownState(treeID)
plan: update/plan_2026_11_08_thread_storage.md（#60190），契约 agent-tree-id
afterEvidence: Go appserver/runtime_router.go implements reload-scoped agent tree ids (agentTreeIDs guarded by agentTreeIDMu); verified by TestAgentTreeIDChangesOnReloadAndIsSharedByChildrenLikeRust
Go appserver/agent_controller.go implements the treeID field plus the agentTreeID() accessor that child agents inherit; verified by TestAgentTreeIDChangesOnReloadAndIsSharedByChildrenLikeRust

records.subject: Preserve model catalogs when starting child agents (#60049)
beforeEvidence: 缺子 agent 启动时保留模型 catalog：appserver/agent_controller.go:107 spawnAgentWithReservedID 与 :502 resolveSpawnModelOverrides 按请求参数/捕获设置重算模型，不保留父 catalog
Go 锚点：appserver/（agent_controller、child spawn）、model/（catalog）
plan: update/plan_2026_11_08_model_2.md（#60049），契约 child-agent-catalog-preservation
afterEvidence: Go model/models_endpoint.go implements serving a child agent's catalog from the in-memory model catalog (RefreshInMemory) instead of forcing an offline refresh; verified by TestChildAgentInheritsParentCatalogLikeRust

records.subject: Carry targeted moderation decisions on final-answer messages (#59842)
beforeEvidence: 缺 final-answer 的定向审核决定与 display metadata：Go 的 protocol/appserver 侧没有 moderation decision 随消息下发的字段
Go 锚点：protocol/（item 结构无审核决定字段）、appserver/（turn_runtime 未携带 decision）
plan: update/plan_2026_11_08_context_budget.md（#59842），契约 final-answer-moderation
afterEvidence: Go appserver/final_answer_moderation*.go implements attaching the targeted moderation decision to the completed final answer; verified by TestFinalAnswerModerationAttachedToCompletedAnswerLikeRust

Go appserver/runtime_router.go implements carrying finalAnswerModeration on the turn runtime so the decision reaches the completed answer; verified by TestFinalAnswerModerationAttachedToCompletedAnswerLikeRust

records.subject: Scope file change approval cancellation to the requesting turn (#59910)
beforeEvidence: 缺「patch 审批取消按发起 turn 收敛」：Go 的取消路径不区分 turn 归属
Go 锚点：appserver/（审批取消处理）、turn/（approval broker）
plan: update/plan_2026_11_08_misc_2.md（#59910），契约 patch-approval-cancel-turn-scope
afterEvidence: Go appserver/server_request.go implements scoping a file change approval cancel to the requesting turn instead of the default turn; verified by TestFileChangeApprovalCancelInterruptsRequestingTurnLikeRust
Go appserver/turn_runtime.go implements interrupting only the requesting turn when a patch approval is cancelled; verified by TestPatchApprovalCancelStaysScopedToRequestingTurnLikeRust

records.subject: Stop retrying terminal runtime authentication denials (#60096)
beforeEvidence: 缺 terminal runtime denial 的分类处理：Go 能解析 x-error-json 的 error.code 但只进 telemetry，recoverUnauthorizedAuth 与 isRetryableResponsesStreamError 都不读它，四个 terminal denial code 零命中
Go 锚点：model/（responses stream 错误处理）、telemetry/
plan: update/plan_2026_11_08_runtime_auth_extra.md（#60096），契约 runtime-auth-terminal-denials
afterEvidence: Go model/responses_agent.go implements classifying terminal runtime auth denials through responseAuthorizationErrorCode and short-circuiting recovery so they surface as sign-in; verified by TestTerminalRuntimeDenialsSurfaceSignInLikeRust
Go model/responses_agent.go implements treating a runtime auth denial as non-recoverable instead of retryable; verified by TestRuntimeAuthDenialIsNotRecoverableAuthErrorLikeRust

records.subject: Reduce SQLite write overhead for thread activity and history (#60006)
beforeEvidence: 缺 SQLite 写放大三项子改动（token 窄更新/历史写准入/日志窗口帧）；底座（pool、ExecWrite busy 重试、BeginImmediate、分区 prune 谓词）已在
Go 锚点：state/（threads/history 写入）、rollout/
plan: update/plan_2026_11_08_thread_storage.md（#60006，拆 a/b/c），契约 thread-token-narrow-update
afterEvidence: Go state/logs.go implements pruning each Rust log partition with one ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING window that computes byte and row limits in a single pass; verified by TestLogsPruneWindowUsesSinglePassLikeRust

Go state/backfill.go implements a token-usage activity narrow update that touches only timestamps and token totals while keeping concurrent metadata edits; verified by TestThreadTokenUpdateKeepsConcurrentMetadataLikeRust
Go state/runtime.go implements serializing local history writes through historyWriter/acquireHistoryWriter before BeginImmediate; verified by TestHistoryWriteAdmission

records.subject: Add atomic bulk channel subscription updates (#59998)
beforeEvidence: 缺原子批量订阅更新：Go 只有单条 SetSubscription，无「一次事务内多目标、失败整体回滚」
Go 锚点：agentboard/（subscriptions 写入）
plan: update/plan_2026_11_08_thread_storage.md（#59998），契约 message-board-bulk-subscriptions
afterEvidence: Go agentboard/local.go implements atomic bulk channel subscription updates in one transaction with all-or-nothing rollback; verified by TestLocalBoardBulkSubscriptionsAreAtomicLikeRust

records.subject: Reduce contention in thread writer lock coordination (#59969)
beforeEvidence: 缺共享协调读：Go 的 writer lock 是独占且阻塞（30s 超时/50ms 重试），Close() 先拿独占再删文件；Rust 已改共享协调 + 拿不到就保留文件
Go 锚点：session/（writer lock）、rollout/（store 协调）
plan: update/plan_2026_11_08_thread_storage.md（#59969），契约 thread-writer-lock-shared-coordination
afterEvidence: Go session/writer_lock.go implements shared coordination so Close does not block on a held coordination lock and keeps the lock file; verified by TestWriterLockCloseDoesNotBlockOnHeldCoordination
Go session/writer_lock.go implements TryAcquireForPublication skipping a live writer while holding coordination; verified by TestTryAcquireForPublicationSkipsLiveWriterAndHoldsCoordination

plan: update/plan_2026_11_08_mcp_lazy.md（#60039），契约 mcp-lazy-stdio-startup
afterEvidence: Go mcp/connection_pool.go implements deferring cached stdio server startup until first use when lazy startup is enabled; verified by TestMcpLazyStdioStartupDefersCachedServersLikeRust
Go appserver/ implements warming the tool catalog cache when a new chat starts; verified by TestToolCatalogCacheWarmsNewChatsLikeRust
